name: L10 SEVN cumulative-reference-disjoint fresh PAN source panel V2
question: Can a portal-specific exact-token witness graph improve address-to-door binding on forty additional SEVN PAN episodes disjoint from all three earlier panels?

exclusion_feasibility.metadata_only_check: A deterministic preflight returned 20 PAN_LEFT plus 20 PAN_RIGHT episodes with 40 distinct addresses and 40 distinct frames after cumulative exclusion.

selection_rule.pixel_blind: Open only coord.hdf5, label.hdf5, graph.pkl, and the three consumed public-source manifests. Do not open images.hdf5, high-res-panos.zip, a viewport, a crop, or any model output.
selection_rule.reference_exclusion: Exclude the union of every canonical street-name plus house-number pair and every panorama frame_id present in any of the three earlier public sources.
selection_rule.within_panel_exclusion: Use each target address and panorama frame once across the full 40-episode panel.
selection_rule.scenario_scope: Freeze only PAN_LEFT and PAN_RIGHT because cumulative exclusion leaves no strictly fresh APPROACH episode.
selection_rule.ordering: Reuse the frozen V1 materializer: original deterministic candidate-goal order, first twenty eligible PAN_LEFT rows, then first twenty remaining eligible PAN_RIGHT rows.
selection_rule.pan_recovery: Keep the original plus or minus 90 degree start and 67.5 degree prescribed pan construction; require before != CORRECT_UNIQUE and after == CORRECT_UNIQUE from human metadata geometry.
selection_rule.prohibited_filters: Do not filter or rank by OCR visibility, image appearance, portal-model output, predecessor output, witness-graph output, or eventual pixel outcome.

stop_rule: Materialize this deterministic cumulative-exclusion panel once, refuse to overwrite outputs, and never replace episodes after pixel outcomes are observed.
claim_boundary: This freezes another same-source SEVN PAN-only Development panel. It is not source-disjoint, action-general, city-disjoint, live-camera, product, user-benefit, or safety evidence.
